gates.name: Privacy, Terms and legal
gates.required: Verify that the final Privacy Policy and Terms match actual hosting and email data flows; satisfy mandatory controller name/address disclosure, applicable POTRAZ licensing/DPO/notifications, international transfer and security duties, retention schedules, data-subject rights and any applicable Consumer Protection Act electronic-transaction particulars. Do not claim compliance without evidence.

gates.name: Production monitoring, backup and rollback
gates.required: service/account owner, alerts, backups, tested restore/rollback rehearsal
